description: Computes columns 2 and 5-9 of the U.S. DOL WH-347 certified payroll form (Rev. January 2025) for one project and one payroll week: hours, 6A rates (OT = base x 1.5), 6B fringe credit, 6C cash in lieu, 7A/7B gross, 8 deductions, 9 net pay, plus fringe paid to each plan and the 6B reconciliation. Amounts are rounded to cents for output only. Same JSON as the `wh347 --json` command. Example: { "workers": [{ "worker": "John Mason", "type": "J", "base_rate": 30, "fringe_health_welfare": 4, "fringe_pension": 2, "st_hours": [8,8,8,8,8], "ot_hours": [4], "other_deductions": 310 }] }.

workers.description: One entry per worker-week on one project, in WH-347 line order.

cash_in_lieu_rate.description: Cash paid in lieu of fringe, $/h (column 6C).

gross_all_work.description: Gross earned for all work, column 7B. Omitted or null = 7A.

ot_hours.description: Overtime hours, day 1 to 7, paid at base rate x 1.5 (missing days = 0).

st_hours.description: Straight-time hours, day 1 to 7 of the payroll week (missing days = 0).

type.description: Column 2: J (journeyworker), RA (registered apprentice) or empty.

name: wh347_payroll_lines
title: WH-347 columns 5-9 for a crew week
